services.name: AI Strategy & Custom ML
services.description: Most AI initiatives stall because nobody knows what to build first. We map the AI landscape from altitude — what to prioritize, what to skip, what it costs, and what it saves. Concrete bets, not a deck that collects dust.
services.elevatorPitch: Summit-level clarity on what to build, what to skip, and what each move costs.

subServices.name: AI Strategy Consulting
subServices.description: A structured 6-stage process from identifying the right problem to deploying AI that runs in production.

process.name: Identify
process.description: Surface the highest-impact use cases for your business. Business assessment, opportunity analysis, ROI estimation, and feasibility studies.

process.name: Hypothesis
process.description: Define what AI can and cannot do for each use case. Problem definition, success metrics, assumption validation, and approach planning.

process.name: Data
process.description: Assess data readiness, quality, and architecture. Data collection, quality assessment, exploratory analysis, and preparation workflows.

process.name: Build
process.description: Prototype development and technical validation. Model selection, training, validation, and performance optimization.

process.name: Train
process.description: Model training, fine-tuning, and evaluation. Hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, performance testing, and bias detection.

process.name: Deploy
process.description: Production deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Production deployment, monitoring systems, scaling infrastructure, and ongoing optimization.
